change: Distinguish exact provider-usage token pricing from conservative accounting when cache detail fields are unavailable.
reason: The repaired transport preserves missing cache fields as null and supplies an upper bound from observed total input/output tokens. Missing cache detail does not mean the entire generation's usage is unresolved.
rules: Exact token price remains null when cache-read or cache-write details are unavailable.
Per-response conservative upper bounds count toward the suite and task limits.
A turn can release its reservation only when every started generation has terminal observed total usage and a safe cost bound.
A generation with missing total usage keeps its reservation and stops further dispatch, including a later suite invocation.
Cached tokens remain a subset of input tokens and reasoning tokens a subset of output tokens; unavailable telemetry is never replaced with zero.
effect: Accounting implementation only. Frozen task wording, expected outcomes, rubric, Luna medium configuration and USD 5/USD 20 limits remain unchanged.
